name: codexpertio/plugin-tracker-sdk
description: Telemetry SDK for WordPress plugins reporting to Plugin Tracker. Consent-gated, opt-in only.

scripts.makepot: wp i18n make-pot . languages/plugin-tracker-sdk.pot --slug=plugin-tracker-sdk --domain=plugin-tracker-sdk --package-name="Plugin Tracker SDK" --exclude=tests,vendor,dist,bin,docs --ignore-domain

_platform_note: 7.4, not the SDK's 7.2 distribution floor. The pin exists to make dependency resolution
deterministic, and it applies to dev tooling too -- PHPStan 2.x requires PHP >=7.4 to RUN,
so a 7.2.5 pin made the analyser un-upgradable while doing nothing for what ships.
The 7.2 floor is enforced by the three things that actually check it: require.php '>=7.2',
phpstan.neon phpVersion 70200, and phpcs.xml.dist testVersion 7.2- -- plus the release
The one thing the old pin silently protected: with platform at 7.4, composer would happily
install a RUNTIME dependency requiring ^7.4, making require.php '>=7.2' a lie. The
check-floor script asserts there are no runtime dependencies at all, which is the actual
